## About
Landmark Auto & Diesel Repair is a locally owned shop in Phoenix. We service gas and light diesel cars, trucks, vans and SUVs, including Sprinter Vans, for drivers in Phoenix, Peoria, Glendale and the neighboring Arizona communities.
Jose owns the shop, and Carl manages it. We'd rather take the time to explain what your vehicle needs than rush you out the door.
From routine oil changes and brake jobs to AC, transmission and diesel engine work, we aim to keep it honest, fair priced and done right.

## Services
- Preventative Maintenance: Oil changes, tune ups and factory scheduled maintenance to head off costly problems later.
- Diesel Repair and Maintenance: Repair and maintenance for light duty diesel cars, vans and trucks.
- Engine Repair: Engine work on gas vehicles as well as diesel trucks and cars.
- Heating and AC Repair: We track down what's keeping your AC or heat from working right.
- Diagnostics: Check engine light on? We use up to date diagnostic equipment to find out what's causing it.
- Transmission Repair: Transmission service and repair, including fluid changes.
- Brake Repair: Brake jobs, from pads and rotors to brake lines and the master cylinder.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on diesels and Sprinter vans?
A: Yes. We service gas and light diesel cars, trucks, vans and SUVs, including Sprinter Vans.

Q: Do you work on foreign and domestic cars?
A: Yes. Our team has more than 30 years of foreign and domestic auto repair experience.

Q: Do you work with Snap Finance?
A: Yes. We've partnered with Snap Finance to make paying for unexpected auto repairs simple and affordable.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Saturday is by appointment only, and we're closed Sunday.
